Article.ArticleTitle: Roll-to-Roll Production of Metal-Organic Framework Coatings for Particulate Matter Removal.

Abstract.AbstractText: A powerful roll-to-roll hot-pressing strategy for mass production of metal-organic framework (MOF)-based filters (MOFilters) using various MOF systems with ranges of substrates is presented. Thus-obtained MOFilters show superior particulate matter removal efficiency under desired working temperatures. Such versatile MOFilters can be scaled up and purposely designed, which endows MOFilters with great potentials in both residential and industrial pollution control.
